comments.content: The variable name is misleading. `$emailThatFailsBothNonStrictButFailsInStrict = 'username@sub..example.com'` claims it fails both non-strict and strict, but this test only checks it under strict mode. The name reads contradictorily ('FailsBothNonStrictButFailsInStrict'). Consider renaming to something like `$emailThatFailsBothNonStrictAndStrict`.
